sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Plant Abyssal Lich is a Witch that starts as a regular Lich, then unlocks the hidden Abyssal Lich ascendancy. After unlocking, you rebuild around plants — Entangle and Thrashing Vines — layered with Thunderstorm for screen-wide plant explosions.

This is NOT Plant Oracle. Oracle is the normal ascendancy path; Abyssal Lich is a hidden transformation with a respec and a different defensive profile. It is tankier at the top end but demands the unlock and a rebuild.

sections.title: Pros and Cons
pros: Borderline unkillable at the top end thanks to low-life + energy shield + damage bypass.
Excellent clear speed from plant explosions.
Strong league-starter feel once the kit is online.
cons: Low-life setup is unintuitive for beginners.
Requires the hidden Abyssal Lich unlock before the real payoff.
Mana-hungry at advanced levels; solved by specific uniques.

sections.title: Is This Build Right For You?
paragraphs: Choose Plant Abyssal Lich if you want a tanky plant build and are willing to do the hidden-ascendancy unlock and a respec. If you want the simpler plant path, Plant Oracle is the lower-friction choice.
Do not copy the endgame planner before you have unlocked Abyssal Lich — the pre-unlock setup is a different build.

sections.title: Abyssal Lich Unlock Route
paragraphs: Abyssal Lich is a hidden ascendancy unlocked by defeating Vessel of Kulemak (reaching the relevant Atlas depth / T14+ maps per the current client). The exact condition must be confirmed against official or current-client data — treat any single-guide claim as a claim to verify, not fact.
Before unlock, you play a normal Lich (or the same node layout). After unlock, you respec ascendancy, passive tree, and gear toward the low-life plant shell.

steps.label: Campaign — Normal Lich
body: Level as a regular Lich using Entangle from level 1; it is available early and smooths the campaign.

steps.label: Early Maps — Hold for Unlock
body: Push to the Atlas depth that triggers the Vessel of Kulemak fight. Do not respec into Abyssal Lich yet.

sections.title: Transformation Into Abyssal Lich
paragraphs: After the unlock, swap to Abyssal Lich, take Eternal Life to lock low life, and rebuild the passive tree and gear for energy-shield-based tankiness. This is a real respec, not a free upgrade.

skills.role: Main clear from level 1; roots and damages packs
notes: Available from level 1, which is why the leveling feels smooth.
whyUse: Entangle is your campaign-smoothing clear and stays core into endgame.

mappingBossingDiff: Strong in packs; pair with Thunderstorm for explosions.

sections.title: How the Plant Kit Works
paragraphs: Entangle roots enemies; Thrashing Vines and Thunderstorm add damage; Accelerated Growth detonates the vines into screen-wide plant explosions. The loop is automatic once cast, which is why clear is fast.
The build leans on a permanent low-life state via Eternal Life: once you have energy shield, life cannot change, locking you below 35% for low-life bonuses.

sections.title: Mapping Loop
paragraphs: Cast Entangle into packs, layer Thrashing Vines and Thunderstorm, and let Accelerated Growth detonate. Move continuously; the explosions do the clearing.

sections.title: Boss Loop
paragraphs: Use Bonestorm for single-target burst on bosses, and keep the plant layers for add clear. Rupture the Flesh makes cursed enemies explode like a free Detonate Dead.

items.question: How much respec do I need after unlock?
answer: It is a real respec of ascendancy, passives, and gear — not a single node. Budget respec currency before committing.

items.question: What if I copy the endgame planner pre-unlock?
answer: You will be missing the ascendancy and low-life layers, so the build will feel weak and fragile. Follow the pre-unlock config first.

sections.title: Defensive Layers
paragraphs: The shell stacks energy shield, the Lich's inherent damage reduction (Soulless Form), the low-life lock, and Atziri's Disdain bypass. It is genuinely tanky at the top end — but only after the layers are all in place.
The biggest beginner trap is assuming the tankiness is free. Without the low-life lock and Atziri's Disdain, you are a squishy caster.

sections.title: Content Fit
paragraphs: Best for T15 maps, delirium, and SSF/HCSSF once geared. Weak for players who refuse the hidden-unlock grind or want a simple league starter.

items.question: Is Abyssal Lich better than Oracle?
answer: At the top end it is tankier and has strong boss DPS, but it requires the hidden unlock and a respec. Oracle is the lower-friction plant path.

items.question: Can I league-start it?
answer: You level as a normal Lich (smooth), but the Abyssal payoff only comes after the hidden unlock. It is not a zero-grind starter.

items.question: Why do I need Atziri's Disdain?
answer: It is the mandatory unique that enables the low-life shell the whole defense is built around.
